additional_info.subject: RE: 0379432 - ID0379432-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R6 170002260] Cause of error code":37 CRM:00641000667
additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
V2G, or Vehicle-to-Grid, refers to technology that allows EV's to discharge energy back into the grid(Charger). When there's a "V2G error" in an EV charger, it typically indicates a malfunction or communication issue between the EV and the grid or charging station.
Common Causes of V2G Errors:
Communication Issues
: Problems in the communication protocols between the EV and the charger can lead to errors. This might be due to outdated software or incompatible systems.
Hardware Malfunctions
: Faulty components in the EV charger or the vehicle's onboard charger can cause the error, but sometimes it is not critical , it will disappear.
Network Connectivity
: A weak or disrupted internet connection can impede the data exchange necessary for V2G operations.
Regulatory Compliance
: Sometimes, regulatory changes or compliance issues can hinder the V2G process.
Why V2G Errors Occur:
Complexity
: The interactions between multiple systems (vehicle, charger, grid) can lead to unforeseen issues.
User Error
: Incorrect setup or usage of the charging system can also contribute to errors.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
